title: PPIA-13 GM Academy Curriculum Extraction — Source Manifest
owner_directive: Include a curated amount of GM Academy material in the PPIA-13 teaching library, including foundations, intermediate, advanced, worldbuilding and GMing Multiversal; add bounded steps if needed.
source_authority_rule: GM Academy PDFs are project-source instructional/design material. They may teach GM craft but do not override canonical Multiversal rules, permissions, feature contracts or repository evidence. Conflicts defer to canonical repository/system truth.
outline_gap_rule: The Multiversal GMing & System Mastery headings are an approved curriculum scaffold only. User-facing lesson claims require grounding in canonical Multiversal repository/game-framework sources; unsupported details remain explicit gaps.
world_creation_tables_rule: World Creation tables may support optional synthetic exercises and examples. Random results are noncanonical prompts and never establish setting truth automatically.
scope_rule: Index all Academy topics for traceability, but initial in-app teaching uses a curated subset. The Academy must not turn required onboarding into a long mandatory course.
